title: 対策本部
cast: りゅうじ・ましろ・はじめ
restoration: 原画の切り出し・規格内の紙色補正（拡大・反転なし）

tasks.script: LEFT ①: stern Ryuji in WHITE CHECK suit/purple tie/moustache/tinted sunglasses tells Hajime 「対策会議だ。」 He points to a vague gigantic frightening silhouette of the rumored 'Cigarman' on a board. RIGHT ②: grand emergency command center with huge banner 「シガーマン対策本部」. Sweet ADULT pale-blonde two-braided Mashiro in beige cardigan and long green skirt has innocently been made the MEETING CHAIR, sitting in an absurdly tall executive chair, everyone earnestly trusts her. Mashiro holding a clipboard nervously says 「僕も怖いよ〜。」 Ryuji bows respectfully saying 「先生、お願いします。」 A tiny narrator arrow to MASHIRO labelled 「本人」 makes clear they appointed Cigarman to defeat Cigarman. No actual monster, smoking, hookah or weapons.
